privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: my_pet stores your pets' data in your own Firebase project. There are no analytics on the content of your records. Your partner can read your data; nobody else.

deleteAll.title: Delete all data
deleteAll.subtitle: Erases pets, vaccines, family and your account.
